title: Tāne and the First Light
subtitle: Ranginui and Papatūānuku
culturalNote: One retelling of the separation of Ranginui and Papatūānuku. Traditions differ across iwi; review te reo pronunciation and cultural details before publication.

sources.title: Ministry for the Environment — Te tīmatanga o te ao Māori

scenes.title: BEFORE THE LIGHT
scenes.caption: A WORLD IN DARKNESS
scenes.narration: Long ago, Ranginui, the sky father, and Papatūānuku, the earth mother, held each other in a close embrace. Between them, the world lay in darkness.

scenes.title: THE CHILDREN
scenes.caption: NO ROOM TO GROW
scenes.narration: Their children, the atua, lived in that narrow space. They longed to stand tall, to stretch, and to see the light beyond the darkness.

scenes.title: A HARD CHOICE
scenes.caption: THE BROTHERS DISAGREE
scenes.narration: The brothers spoke of separating their parents. But Tāwhirimātea, guardian of the winds, fiercely opposed the idea. He wanted his parents to remain together.

scenes.title: THE FIRST ATTEMPTS
scenes.caption: THE EMBRACE HELD
scenes.narration: One by one, the brothers tried to lift the sky. Yet the embrace of Ranginui and Papatūānuku was too strong. Nothing would move.

scenes.title: TĀNE'S STRENGTH
scenes.caption: TĀNE PUSHED UPWARD
scenes.narration: Then Tāne, guardian of the forests, lay on his back upon the earth. Pressing his feet against the sky, he gathered his strength, and pushed.

scenes.title: TE AO MĀRAMA
scenes.caption: LIGHT ENTERED THE WORLD
scenes.narration: Slowly, the sky rose. A thin golden line opened between earth and heaven, growing wider and brighter, until the world was filled with light.

scenes.title: THE STORM
scenes.caption: TĀWHIRIMĀTEA'S ANGER
scenes.narration: Tāwhirimātea grieved the separation. He rose to join his father in the sky, sending fierce winds and storms across the land below.

scenes.title: A LIVING WORLD
scenes.caption: LIFE BENEATH THE SKY
scenes.narration: Beneath Ranginui, forests spread across Papatūānuku. Rain fell from the heavens, and life grew in the space between. This is one telling of how light entered the world.
